notes: Line forms: {n} Feyre's narration, first person past tense, shown in italics; {s,e,t} a line spoken aloud (speaker, portrait expression, text); {hint} a game tip on its own card; {choices:[{t,goto,do}]}; {do:[actions]}; {goto}. Any line or choice may carry if_flag, if_not_flag, if_item, if_not_item or if_chapter. Wording is written for the game; the few short book lines kept are listed in quotes.json.

lines.n: The snow on the road into the village was trampled brown and black. Nesta and Elain had come along the moment they saw the hides in my satchel.

do.text: Sell the hides. The mercenary in the square buys pelts. Then take the east road home.

lines.t: May the Immortal Light shine upon you, sisters. Have you a moment to hear of the Blessed?
We don't.

lines.n: Nesta pushed back her sleeve to show the iron bracelet on her wrist. The acolyte flinched.

lines.t: This is what you ought to wear. Not little silver bells to call those monsters to you.
Prythian is a land of plenty, and our masters are kind.
You're fighting an uphill battle.
A worthy one.
No. It isn't.
Remember what I told you. Stay out of the deep woods.
I don't trade goods for my work. Coin only.
I'm selling, not buying. A wolf pelt and a doe hide. I took them myself.
You weren't lying about the size. Doesn't look like a faerie, though.

lines.n: She paid more than they were worth. A good deal more.

lines.t: Somebody did the same for me once. Call it paying it back.
One hunter to another: keep out of the deep woods. More of them slip through the Wall every year.
A man I guarded swore a pack of martax crossed in the night. Bodies like bears, heads like lions, three rows of teeth. Half a village in ribbons.

do.text: Spend a little coin at the charm stall if you like. Then take the east road home.

lines.n: A stall of charms and trinkets and little bits of iron, priced to the village's fears.
The cobbler pretended not to look at my satchel. His usual offers were an insult, and today would be no different.
Isaac was long gone down the road.
Isaac Hale leaned against a wall across the square, arms folded. He tipped his head the way he always did and wandered off toward the old barn.

lines.t: Do be careful, you two.

lines.n: It wasn't love. It never had been. Just an hour that belonged to nobody but us.

do.text: Later, the light outside the barn had gone long and grey.

lines.t: He'll marry some farmer's daughter with a fat dowry soon enough.
I'll find something for Father. I promise.
Feyre... the spice stall smells like our old house.

choices.t: Give her a little coin. (5 coin)

lines.t: Are you going to sell them? The mercenary keeps looking over.
See you at home.

lines.n: That evening she came home with a new chisel for Father's carving. And Nesta chopped wood without being asked.

lines.t: Of course. You're right.
Not until the hides are sold.

lines.n: After another supper of venison we sat around the fire for the quiet hour before bed. Father dozed with his cane across his knee.
